## Descriptive statistics for dependent measures in the lexical vs. grammatical condition {-}
Descriptive statistics (means and standard deviations) for the three dependent measures: skipping probability, first fixation duration, and gaze duration. These values represent raw means and standard deviations and are not adjusted for suffix frequency, length, predictability, or participant variability. These factors are accounted for in the mixed-effects models reported in the main text.

```{r descriptivestats, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# skipping probability
skip_desc <- df_affix %>%
  mutate(skipped = as.integer(FIRST_PASS_FIXATION_COUNT == 0)) %>%
  group_by(affix_type) %>%
  summarise(
    skipping_M = mean(skipped),
    skipping_SD = sd(skipped),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# FFD and GD (excluding skipped trials)
duration_desc <- df_affix_without_skipped %>%
  group_by(affix_type) %>%
  summarise(
    FFD_M = mean(FIRST_FIXATION_DURATION),
    FFD_SD = sd(FIRST_FIXATION_DURATION),
    GD_M = mean(GAZE_DURATION),
    GD_SD = sd(GAZE_DURATION),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# combine tables
desc_table <- skip_desc %>%
  left_join(duration_desc, by = "affix_type") %>%
  mutate(
    `Skipping probability` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", skipping_M, skipping_SD),
    `First fixation duration (ms)` = sprintf("%.0f (%.0f)", FFD_M, FFD_SD),
    `Gaze duration (ms)` = sprintf("%.0f (%.0f)", GD_M, GD_SD)
  ) %>%
  select(
    affix_type,
    `Skipping probability`,
    `First fixation duration (ms)`,
    `Gaze duration (ms)`
  )

# rename conditions
desc_table$affix_type <- recode(
  desc_table$affix_type,
  lexical = "Lexical suffixes",
  grammatical = "Grammatical suffixes"
)

# transpose so measures are rows
desc_table <- desc_table %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -affix_type,
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "values"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = affix_type,
    values_from = values
  )

# convert to huxtable
desc_ht <- as_hux(desc_table)

# formatting
colnames(desc_ht) <- c(
  "Measure",
  "Lexical suffixes M (SD)",
  "Grammatical suffixes M (SD)"
)

align(desc_ht)[, 2:3] <- "right"
align(desc_ht)[, 1] <- "left"

caption(desc_ht) <- 
  "Descriptive statistics for eye-movement measures by suffix type"

top_border(desc_ht)[1, ] <- 1
bottom_border(desc_ht)[1, ] <- 1

desc_ht

```

## Checking for spillover effects {-}
Here the log-transformed frequencies of the root and the fill suffix are included in the main models to test for spillover frequency effects.

### Skipping model {-}

```{r spillover effects skipping, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## skipping model

df_skip_model <- df_affix %>%
  mutate(
    skipped = as.integer(FIRST_PASS_FIXATION_COUNT == 0)    # 1 = skipped, 0 = fixated
  )

model_skipping_spillover <- glmer(
  skipped ~ affix_type + affix_frequency_log + affix_length + predictability_log + fill_affix_frequency_log + root_frequency_log +
    (1 | participant_id), # random intercepts for participants
  data = df_skip_model,
  family = "binomial"
)

# make a table

model_skipping_spillover_tbl <- tbl_regression(
  model_skipping_spillover,
  exponentiate = FALSE,
  tidy_fun = function(x, ...) {
    broom.mixed::tidy(x, effects = "fixed", conf.int = FALSE)
  }
)

model_skipping_spillover_tbl <- model_skipping_spillover_tbl %>%
  modify_header(
    estimate ~ "β", 
    std.error ~ "SE",
    statistic ~ "t",
    p.value ~ "p"
  )

# create huxtable
model_skipping_spillover_ht <- model_skipping_spillover_tbl %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  as_hux()

model_skipping_spillover_ht

```

### First fixation duration model {-}

```{r spillover effects ffd, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## ffd model

# trials where target affix is skipped are excluded from the ffd and gd analyses
df_affix_without_skipped <- df_affix %>%
  filter(FIRST_PASS_FIXATION_COUNT != 0) %>%
  mutate(FIRST_FIXATION_DURATION_log = log(FIRST_FIXATION_DURATION),
         GAZE_DURATION_log = log(GAZE_DURATION))

model_ffd_spillover <- lmer(
  FIRST_FIXATION_DURATION_log ~ affix_type + affix_frequency_log + affix_length + predictability_log + fill_affix_frequency_log + root_frequency_log +
    (1 | participant_id),
  data = df_affix_without_skipped
)

# make a table

model_ffd_spillover_tbl <- tbl_regression(
  model_ffd_spillover,
  exponentiate = FALSE,
  tidy_fun = function(x, ...) {
    broom.mixed::tidy(x, effects = "fixed", conf.int = FALSE)
  }
)

model_ffd_spillover_tbl <- model_ffd_spillover_tbl %>%
  modify_header(
    estimate ~ "β", 
    std.error ~ "SE",
    statistic ~ "t",
    p.value ~ "p"
  )

# create huxtable
model_ffd_spillover_ht <- model_ffd_spillover_tbl %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  as_hux()

model_ffd_spillover_ht
```

## Relationship between fixation density and word length for fast vs. slow readers {-}
For this plot, participants were divided into two equally sized groups based on reading speed.

```{r fixation density and word length - slow and fast readers, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=5, dpi=300}

# first divide participants into two groups
df_reading_times <- df_affix %>% 
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  summarise(mean_rt_per_char_trials = mean(rt_per_char_trial)) %>%
  mutate(
    speed_group = ifelse(
      ntile(mean_rt_per_char_trials, 2) == 1,
      "fastest",
      "slowest"
    )
  )

# add speed group to fixations_all_words
fixations_all_words <- fixations_all_words %>%
  left_join(df_reading_times %>% select(participant_id, speed_group), by = "participant_id")
# and to df_affix (for later use)
df_affix <- df_affix %>%
  left_join(df_reading_times %>% select(participant_id, speed_group), by = "participant_id")

# visualize
z <- fixations_all_words %>%
  group_by(speed_group, current_word_length) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_fix_density = mean(fixations_per_char),
    n_words = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fixation_density_plot_by_speed <- ggplot(z, aes(x = current_word_length, y = mean_fix_density)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_words)) +
  facet_wrap(~ speed_group) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "word length (in characters)",
    y = "fixations per character"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

fixation_density_plot_by_speed
```

## Quadratic model used to determine turning point {-}

Quadratic mixed-effects model of fixation density as a function of word length.

```{r fit model and calculate turning point}
model_fix_per_char_quadratic <- lmer(   
  fixations_per_char ~ current_word_length + I(current_word_length^2) + (1|participant_id),   
  data = fixations_per_char_words)  

# calculate turning point 
coefs <- fixef(model_fix_per_char_quadratic) 
a <- coefs["I(current_word_length^2)"] 
b <- coefs["current_word_length"] 
turning_point <- -b / (2 * a) 
turning_point
```

The estimated turning point occurred at a word length of 9.2 letters.

## Model of fixation density across word regions and baseline words {-}

Mixed-effects model of fixation density with word region, region frequency, and region length as fixed effects, and random intercepts for participants.

```{r fixation density on the four word regions and the baseline words, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## add columns containing inflection frequency (both absolute and log10-transformed)

# add inflection column
fix_report_target_word_and_baseline <- 
  fix_report_target_word_and_baseline %>%
  mutate(
    inflection = pmap_chr(
      list(sentence_2_kal, sentence_2_ids, inflection_ids),
      function(sent, sent_ids_raw, infl_ids) {
        
        # 1. Turn sentence_2_ids into a vector
        sent_ids <- str_split(sent_ids_raw, ",\\s*")[[1]]
        
        # 2. Match inflection IDs to sentence IDs
        positions <- match(infl_ids, sent_ids)
        
        # 3. Split sentence into characters
        chars <- str_split(sent, "")[[1]]
        
        # 4. Extract characters
        paste0(chars[positions], collapse = "")
      }
    )
  )

# make df containing inflection frequency
df_inflection_frequency <- fix_report_target_word_and_baseline %>%
  group_by(inflection) %>%
  summarise("inflection_frequency_absolute" = NA)

df_inflection_frequency <- df_inflection_frequency %>% 
  mutate(inflection_frequency_absolute = recode(
    inflection,
    "aangat" = 9454,
    "aat" = 606457,
    "ami" = 250904,
    "amiuk" = 18667,
    "aq" = 699499,
    "at" = 1473379,
    "gaa" = 79801,
    "gami" = 19840,
    "gamik" = 13697,
    "li" = 286947,
    "lluni" = 165895,
    "llutik" = 93348,
    "luni" = 346093,
    "lutik" = 196583,
    "mat" = 145798,
    "mata" = 51333,
    "mmat" = 71007,
    "mmata" = 28507,
    "paa" = 104292,
    "paat" = 85273,
    "pai" = 39738,
    "poq" = 673407,
    "pput" = 291821,
    "put" = 628027,
    "soq" = 349321,
    "sut" = 550045,
    "vaa" = 48810,
    "vaat" = 44830,
    "vai" = 21200,
    "voq" = 289743,
    "vunga" = 12537,
    .default = NA_real_
  ))

# note: for the inflection frequencies, we used the "words ends with" search function in the corpus
# so some of the hits may not actually be the same inflection but the ending of something else
# that just happens to be spelled the same

# merge with fix_report
fix_report_target_word_and_baseline <- 
  fix_report_target_word_and_baseline %>%
  left_join(df_inflection_frequency, by = "inflection")

# add column containing log10-transformed inflection frequency
fix_report_target_word_and_baseline <- 
  fix_report_target_word_and_baseline %>%
  mutate(
    inflection_frequency_log = log10(inflection_frequency_absolute)
  )

## create column region_frequency_log
fix_report_target_word_and_baseline <- 
  fix_report_target_word_and_baseline %>%
  mutate(
    region_frequency_log = case_when(
      fixation_position == "root" ~ root_frequency_log,
      fixation_position == "affix" ~ affix_frequency_log,
      fixation_position == "fill" ~ fill_affix_frequency_log,
      fixation_position == "inflection" ~ inflection_frequency_log,
      fixation_position == "word" ~ baseline_word_frequency_log,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

## calculate fixation density on each region
fix_density_df <- 
  fix_report_target_word_and_baseline %>%
  group_by(trial_key, participant_id, fixation_position) %>%
  summarise(
    n_fixations = n(),
    region_length = first(region_length),
    region_frequency_log = first(region_frequency_log),
    fixation_density = n_fixations / region_length,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## fit a lmer model

fix_density_df$fixation_position <- 
  factor(fix_density_df$fixation_position,
         levels = c("affix", "root", "fill", "inflection", "word"),
         labels = c("target suffix", "root", "fill", "inflection", "baseline word"))

model_fix_dens <- lmer(
  fixation_density ~ fixation_position + 
    region_frequency_log + 
    region_length + 
    (1 | participant_id),
  data = fix_density_df
)

## make a table

model_fix_dens_tbl <- tbl_regression(
  model_fix_dens,
  exponentiate = FALSE,
  tidy_fun = function(x, ...) {
    broom.mixed::tidy(x, effects = "fixed", conf.int = FALSE)
  }
)

model_fix_dens_tbl <- model_fix_dens_tbl %>%
  modify_header(
    estimate ~ "β", 
    std.error ~ "SE",
    statistic ~ "t",
    p.value ~ "p"
  )

# create huxtable
model_fix_dens_ht <- model_fix_dens_tbl %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  as_hux()

model_fix_dens_ht

```
